decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal, and card draw to stall the opponent's threats. The deck aims to stabilize the board while slowly building card advantage through cards like Tamiyo and Meticulous Archive. It also utilizes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Phelia to pressure the opponent while maintaining control of the game. The mana base is optimized for consistency and to support the various color requirements of the spells in the deck. The synergy of the cards is designed to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a long game.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play with Show and Tell or Sneak Attack. It also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect your combo pieces, along with cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm for card selection. The deck's goal is to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats while disrupting their strategy with counterspells and stax effects.

The main concept of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze, while maintaining a strong board presence with aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Nethergoyf. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm are used to dig for key cards and keep the deck running smoothly. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to deal with threats efficiently. Overall, the goal is to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan, ultimately leading to a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing powerful counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and filtering spells to ensure consistency in finding the necessary control pieces. The creatures in the deck provide additional value and threats to win the game. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck and provide flexibility in playing various spells. Ultimately, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and gain control of the game before securing the win.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with a combination of removal spells and hand disruption while deploying threats quickly to apply pressure. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by efficiently dealing with the opponent's threats and making use of powerful disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize. By efficiently managing the opponent's resources and carefully timing its own threats, this deck seeks to outpace and overwhelm the opponent to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to establish early aggressive board presence with efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Swords to Plowshares, and Cabal Therapy. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional pressure and card advantage. Additionally, the deck utilizes synergies with creatures like Ocelot Pride and Guide of Souls to create a formidable battlefield. The deck also includes utility lands and removal spells to control the game and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using various reanimation spells such as Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave. The key strategy is to discard high-impact creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Faithless Looting and Unmask, then use reanimation spells to bring them back into play ahead of schedule. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to control the opponent's hand and ensure the combo can go off smoothly.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Stifle, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while staying ahead in card advantage with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also includes threats like Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to close out the game. Land destruction with Wasteland and the ability to recur spells with Mystic Sanctuary further enhances the deck's control strategy.

This deck focuses on playing disruptive creatures like Thalia, Archon of Emeria, and Anointed Peacekeeper to control the opponent's resources. With cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland, it aims to keep the opponent from developing their board while quickly building up its own. The addition of cards like Sheltered by Ghosts and Ancient Tomb allows for mana acceleration and protection, while Witch Enchanter and Clarion Conqueror add versatility to the deck's strategy. The aggressive playstyle and resource denial make this deck a formidable opponent in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures with disruptive abilities to gain control of the game early on. By using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down opponents, the deck aims to establish a board presence quickly and overwhelm the opponent. With powerful creatures like Clarion Conqueror and Witch Enchanter, the deck can maintain pressure and close out the game efficiently. This deck is designed to be fast, disruptive, and aggressive, using a combination of creatures and spells to control the tempo of the game and secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Emry, Lurker of the Loch and artifacts like Mox Opal and Urza's Bauble to generate card advantage and mana acceleration. The deck aims to assemble The Fantasticar combo, utilizing Mishra's Bauble and Skateboard to go infinite and draw the entire deck. It also includes disruption elements like Sink into Stupor and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck is focused on quickly assembling the combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with card advantage and resilient threats.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game quickly and efficiently. By using cards like Brainstorm, Doomsday, and Force of Will, the player can manipulate their deck, protect their combo pieces, and disrupt their opponent's strategy. The Fantasticar is a key piece of the combo, along with Thassa's Oracle and Lion's Eye Diamond, which can lead to a game-winning sequence. With the right timing and sequencing of spells, this deck can take control of the game and secure a victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game using The Fantasticar, Doomsday, and Thassa's Oracle. The deck utilizes cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate fast mana, while also including disruption and card selection in the form of Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Brainstorm. The goal is to efficiently set up a win condition by carefully planning out the sequence of cards needed to win the game in a single turn.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy creatures like Guide of Souls, Amped Raptor, and Voice of Victory to overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Static Prison help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Goblin Bombardment provides additional reach to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and defensive options like Karakas and Lazotep Quarry to control the board and protect your creatures. The combination of aggressive creatures, disruption, and removal creates a fast-paced and powerful strategy for aggressive gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get big creatures like Griselbrand and Koma, World-Eater into play through reanimation spells such as Reanimate and Goryo's Vengeance. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize, Collective Brutality, and Cabal Therapy to control the opponent's resources. The mana base is optimized for efficient reanimation, using cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to help power out the big threats early in the game. Overall, the deck aims to combo off and overwhelm the opponent with powerful, reanimated creatures.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, disruption through hand disruption like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy, and utilizing sacrifice effects such as Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The deck aims to quickly put pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Voice of Victory while disrupting their game plan and removing threats with cards like Swords to Plowshares. Additionally, the mana base supports the deck's color requirements with fetch lands like Marsh Flats and dual lands like Plateau and Scrubland.
